test.create_query: CREATE TABLE array_min_max_index_perf_u64 (case_id UInt8, a Array(UInt64)) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE array_min_max_index_perf_float (case_id UInt8, a Array(Float64)) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE array_min_max_index_perf_string (case_id UInt8, a Array(String)) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_u64 SELECT 1, arrayMap(x -> if(x = number % 128, toUInt64('18446744073709551615'), x), range(128)) FROM numbers(10000)
INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_u64 SELECT 2, arrayMap(x -> if(x = number % 16384, toUInt64('18446744073709551615'), x), range(16384)) FROM numbers(40)
INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_u64 SELECT 3, range(512) FROM numbers(10000)
INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_float SELECT 1, arrayMap(x -> if(x = number % 2048, toFloat64('1000000'), toFloat64(x)), range(2048)) FROM numbers(2000)
INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_float SELECT 2, arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(x) - 8192, range(16384)) FROM numbers(40)
INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_string SELECT 1, arrayMap(x -> concat('item-', toString(x)), range(32)) FROM numbers(10000)
test.query: SELECT sum(arrayMinIndex(a) + arrayMaxIndex(a)) FROM array_min_max_index_perf_u64 WHERE case_id IN (1, 2) FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(indexOf(a, arrayMin(a)) + indexOf(a, arrayMax(a))) FROM array_min_max_index_perf_u64 WHERE case_id IN (1, 2) FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(arrayMinIndex(x -> x % 97, a) + arrayMaxIndex(x -> x % 97, a)) FROM array_min_max_index_perf_u64 WHERE case_id = 3 FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(indexOf(arrayMap(x -> x % 97, a), arrayMin(x -> x % 97, a)) + indexOf(arrayMap(x -> x % 97, a), arrayMax(x -> x % 97, a))) FROM array_min_max_index_perf_u64 WHERE case_id = 3 FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(arrayMinIndex(x, y -> x + y, a, a) + arrayMaxIndex(x, y -> x + y, a, a)) FROM array_min_max_index_perf_u64 WHERE case_id = 3 FORMAT Null

SELECT sum(indexOf(arrayMap(x, y -> x + y, a, a), arrayMin(x, y -> x + y, a, a)) + indexOf(arrayMap(x, y -> x + y, a, a), arrayMax(x, y -> x + y, a, a))) FROM array_min_max_index_perf_u64 WHERE case_id = 3 FORMAT Null
